Name: Cost Growth Cascade
Pathway: Healthcare costs rise > wages → Premiums increase → Employers shift to employees → Higher OOP exposure → More spending to healthcare → Less discretionary spending
Mechanism: Healthcare cost growth has structural drivers (aging, technology, consolidation) that aren't easily contained. Costs flow through to consumers regardless of insurance.
Feedback Loops: Higher costs → more uninsured → more uncompensated care → higher costs
Breakpoint: Healthcare spending crowds out other essential spending
Notes: Medical CPI 2.5% Apr (moderating) but Mercer 2026 +6.7% total trend (15-yr high) and Rx +9.4% large-emp keep cost-growth-vs-wage gap intact at employer-spend layer. Updated 2026-06-08.

Name: Care Deferral Cascade
Pathway: High OOP cost → Defer 'non-essential' care → Condition worsens → Eventually requires acute/emergency care → Higher costs than timely treatment → Medical debt
Mechanism: Cost barriers create false savings. Deferred care compounds into larger problems. $200 preventive visit becomes $20,000 hospitalization.
Feedback Loops: Deferral → worse health → higher costs → more deferral
Notes: 36% deferral (KFF Apr 2026 reprint); 18% report worsened health. NIPA CONFIRMATION (Jun 8): BEA Q1 2026 2nd est shows healthcare-services as LARGEST contributor to consumer-services downward revision — care-avoidance now macro-visible. Confidence 75→80%. Updated 2026-06-08.

Name: Medical Debt Spiral
Pathway: Major medical event → Costs exceed ability to pay → Medical debt accrues → Payment plan OR collections → Credit damage → Reduced access to credit → Financial fragility → Potential bankruptcy
Mechanism: Medical debt is uniquely damaging: unchosen, unforeseeable, potentially massive. A single diagnosis can generate debt taking years to resolve.
Feedback Loops: Debt stress → reduced care adherence → worse health → more debt
Breakpoint: Medical costs exceed ability to pay
Notes: $88B baseline (frozen 2021). CFPB enforcement neutered 2026 (6 actions dismissed). ACA cliff acceleration loading new uninsured cohort 6mo early — H2 2026 surge mechanism intact. Updated 2026-06-08.

Name: Medication Non-Adherence Cascade
Pathway: Rx prescribed → OOP cost exceeds comfort → Patient skips/splits doses → Condition poorly controlled → Preventable crisis → Hospitalization/ER → Higher costs + worse outcomes
Mechanism: Non-adherence is dangerous cost-saving. Insulin rationing has caused deaths. Cardiovascular non-adherence causes preventable heart attacks.
Feedback Loops: Non-adherence → crisis → fear → over-adherence → cost → non-adherence
Notes: REFRESHED Jun 8: KFF Apr 2026 wave shows 43% composite cost-avoidance / 27% didn't fill / 19% cut doses; uninsured sub-65 58% Rx non-adherence (2x insured rate). Magnitude exceeds 2022 baseline. Updated 2026-06-08.

Name: DOC-to-CARL Transmission
Pathway: Healthcare cost stress (DOC vectors) → Consumer response (cut spending, defer care, accrue debt) → Spending displacement + Debt accumulation + Credit damage → CARL vectors deteriorate
Mechanism: Healthcare transmits through: (1) Spending displacement - immediate, (2) Debt accumulation - medium-term, (3) Deferred care consequences - long-term. Healthcare is unavoidable so transmission is not optional.
Feedback Loops: CARL stress → less preventive care → worse health → more DOC stress
Breakpoint: Healthcare costs materially impact consumer financial health
Notes: Phase 2-3 (Straining → Deferring). Spending displacement channel now NIPA-confirmed (BEA Q1 2nd est). Debt accumulation channel pulled forward by ACA cliff acceleration. Confidence 80→85%. Updated 2026-06-08.

Name: ACA Subsidy Cliff → Uninsured Cascade
Pathway: Enhanced ACA subsidies expired Dec 2025 → Premium doubles for subsidized enrollees → Open-enrollment -4.9% → MID-YEAR effectuated -17 to -21% Feb→Apr 2026 → 27% of drop concentrated in 400-500% FPL "subsidy cliff" cohort (-44% in that band) → adverse selection premium spiral → New uninsured cohort → Deferred care + no-pay ER use → Medical debt surge H2 2026
Mechanism: ACA cliff is an acute policy trigger layered onto structural stress. Unlike gradual cost increases, subsidy expiry creates sudden premium shock. Realized attrition (Feb-Apr 2026) is running ~9pp WORSE than 2025 same-period — death-spiral risk in individual market.
Feedback Loops: No coverage → defer until crisis → ER visit → uncompensated care → hospital loss → further consolidation/closure → more access loss
Breakpoint: Critical: -17 to -26% full-year effectuated (Wakely range); avg premium $113→$178 (+58%) for stayers
Cross Domain: POLLY (ACA premium / enrollment), CARL (consumer spending, credit, K-shape lower-middle cohort), HOMER (deferred rent while paying premiums)
Trigger: ACA subsidy lapse (occurred Dec 31 2025) — FIRING REALIZED
Notes: [UPGRADED Jun 8] Status was ACTIVE (loading); now ACTIVE-REALIZED. Mid-year attrition 6mo ahead of baseline. Confidence 85→90%. 400-500% FPL concentration is the K-shape lower-middle signal that bridges to CARL V8. SV-DOC-2026-06-08-01.

Name: Employer Benefits Cost → Top-40% Wage Crowd-Out
Pathway: Mercer 2026 employer cost +6.7% (15-yr high) + Rx +9.4% + GLP-1 = ~20% Rx spend → Plan renewal Q3-Q4 2026 → Employer absorbs OR passes to worker via: (a) higher premium share, (b) higher deductible, (c) GLP-1 exclusion / clinical-management gate, (d) wage stagnation as benefits cost absorbs comp pool → Top-40% real-wage erosion → CARL K-shape converging downward at top tercile
Mechanism: Top-40% real wage has been holding up the K-shape upper leg. A measurable employer benefits-cost shock (first in 15 years) provides a new transmission channel distinct from bottom-60% cost-squeeze. Renewal cycle creates a discrete 6-18 month lag from shock to worker P&L. GLP-1 exclusion is the most visible plan-design lever — Express Scripts' Evernorth EnReachRx GLP-1 network signals PBM pivot.
Feedback Loops: Employer pricing pressure → tighter formulary → access denial → care-deferral spreads upward into top tercile → upper-cohort survey numbers worsen → political pressure → policy intervention OR not
Breakpoint: Employer plan-design crystallization Q3-Q4 2026 (DOC-P07 watch); top-tercile real-wage compression in Atlanta Fed WGT 2027
Cross Domain: CARL (real-wage K-shape, V8 K-shape converging, V12 stagflation services-side stickiness), POLLY (premium / plan design)
